subject: Draft MAP & pricing ask — ClearPath AI (milestone owners + commit request)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ava Stone <ava.stone@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Draft MAP attached + next steps

Hi Ava — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan attached so we can align on owners and dates. Highlights: 

- Business objective: Reduce query latency for search ranking models and move embeddings to Redwood in Q3.
- Target close: preferred close 2026-07-30 to meet Q3 rollout; alternative finish by 2026-08-15.
- Milestones (draft):
  1) Contract & PO approved (Procurement) — target 2026-07-15 — owner: ClearPath Procurement
  2) Technical kickoff & SSO onboarding — target 2026-07-20 — owner: ClearPath Eng & Redwood SE
  3) Pilot (10k qps equivalent) — target 2026-07-30 — owner: ClearPath Eng / Redwood SE
  4) Production rollout & capacity commit — target 2026-08-15 — owner: ClearPath Product / Redwood Ops
- Dependencies: SSO + VPC peering (ClearPath networking), legal review of data residency clause, committed capacity level for pricing band.

Ask from our side: review the attached MAP and confirm owners / any internal approval gates. I also flagged a pricing/commit question below — given your projected Q3 volume, would you consider a 1yr commit? We can put together a commit-based pricing proposal.

Attachments: ClearPath_MAP_v1.0.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Next steps: if you can confirm owners by EOD Thursday (6/11) we'll update the MAP and escalate the pricing ask to my sales leader for approval.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Ava Stone <ava.stone@clearpath.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@clearpath.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearpath.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:08:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Draft MAP attached + next steps

Thanks Neha — this looks good. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement: our internal PO and budget window requires signoff by 2026-07-12. Samir (copied) owns procurement scheduling.
- SSO: we prefer Okta; engineering will need an SSO checklist.
- Commit: we are open to a 1yr commit if the economics work; need to see an example pricing band.

I'll confirm internal owners by 6/11 EOD as requested. Attaching our procurement timeline for reference.

Best,
Ava Stone
Head of Product | ClearPath AI
ava.stone@clearpath.ai

Attachments: procurement_timeline_clearpath.pdf (PDF)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ava Stone <ava.stone@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:03:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Draft MAP attached + next steps

Great context — looping in a couple of technical notes that will affect milestone dates: 

- SSO / Okta: our SSO integration checklist is attached (SSO_integration_notes.docx). The SSO onboarding typically takes 5 business days if ClearPath can provide test metadata and a staging Okta app. Suggest bumping the technical kickoff to 2026-07-22 to allow procurement to land first.
- Pilot sizing: to hit the 10k qps equivalent we recommend a preliminary perf test during the kickoff week (adds 3 days to pilot scope).
- KV cache: there is a known performance tuning step that requires a short config change during pilot — I'll own that with ClearPath Eng.

If we accept the procurement date Samir shared, new feasible targets would be:
  Tech kickoff: 2026-07-22
  Pilot completion: 2026-08-02
  Production commit & rollout: 2026-08-18

I'll update the MAP after we confirm owners.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments: SSO_integration_notes.docx (docx)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Stone <ava.stone@clearpath.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearpath.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: MAP v1.1 & pricing ask — request for pricing approval/credits

Team — attaching MAP v1.1 (updated milestones/dates per Rishi and ClearPath). High level commercial context and approval ask below: 

Commercial summary:
- Customer: ClearPath AI (mid-market, series B)
- Proposed: 1-year committed capacity — target commit: $360k ARR (equates to ~30% of projected Q3 token volume at conservative usage)
- Requested concessions from customer: none beyond commit.
- Our ask to leadership: provide a pricing path supporting a 1yr commit with either (A) 25% list discount + $30k onboarding credit OR (B) 20% discount + $20k credit + reduced SLA response window (if needed).
- Rationale: higher probability of renewal and upsell if we price aggressively to hit their Q3 production window. Competing vendors have offered pilot credits; we need to be competitive.

Risks/impact:
- Revenue: 25% discount reduces gross by ~90k first-year but increases close probability quickly.
- Capacity: we should reserve dedicated pool for Q3 if commit accepted — ops impact to be quantified.

Request: Ben / Jonas — can you review and confirm which pricing path you’d approve to take to exec/legal? If we have approval by 6/18 EOB, I’ll present to ClearPath procurement and aim for their 7/12 PO date.

Attachments: ClearPath_MAP_v1.1.xlsx

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MAP v1.1 & pricing ask — request for pricing approval/credits

Jonas — forwarding Neha's note and MAP. This is a >$300k ARR mid-market opportunity with a tight procurement window (PO 7/12). Customer is sensitive to credits (peers offered pilot support) and wants a one-year commit. We recommend option A (25% + $30k credit) to lock the deal and meet Q3 timeline.

Quick bullets: 
- Likelihood of close this quarter with option A: high (70%+)
- If we push option B (20% + $20k), they may delay the PO and push pilot to late July — risk to our Q3 cadence.
- Operational ask: if approved, we will reserve a dedicated burst pool for their pilot week — small short-term capacity risk.

Can we get a quick decision? Neha needs to respond to procurement by Friday 6/18.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Mid-Market Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: LegalOps <legalops@redwood.com>, ProductOps <productops@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP v1.1 & pricing ask — request for pricing approval/credits

Thanks for the summary — I reviewed the MAP and commercial ask. Decision: provisionally approve Option B (20% discount + $20k onboarding credit), with the following conditions:

1) Legal to fast-track a standard MSA addendum and mark data residency clause as \"customer-provided\" to avoid extended legal delays.
2) ProductOps to confirm the burst pool reservation and estimated cost delta (to be covered from the deal expense line).
3) Neha/Ben to commit to a 30-day renewal/usage review cadence and specific upsell milestones in the MAP (add section for Q4 upsell trigger).

Action items I own: loop LegalOps and ProductOps (copied) to confirm feasibility. If LegalOps flags a migration of the data residency clause, escalate to me immediately.

Neha — proceed with Option B language to procurement and ask for the PO by 7/12. If procurement pushes back, escalate to me and I'll support a limited exec credit.

Jonas Weber
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
